items.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024
items.q: But now Stan was a great leader. And the band was a real challenge in many ways... when I was coming back to Woody’s band.

ctx.x: Lugubrious swing. There’s another quote from Ed Soph.
But now Stan was a great leader. And the band was a real challenge in many ways, which would be another six hours. But — now I’ve lost my train of thought when I was coming back to Woody’s band.
Well we were talking about swing and Stan.
